model_annotation: The plot illustrates the coverage of different language models as a function of the number of completions (k), with k ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸ on a logarithmic scale along the x-axis. The y-axis represents coverage, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.8. Four lines are shown, each corresponding to a different model: Llama-3B (solid blue line with circular markers), Llama-3B + FT (dashed green line with triangular markers), Llama-1B (solid light blue line with circular markers), and Llama-1B + FT (dashed light green line with triangular markers). All lines exhibit an increasing trend in coverage as k increases, with the Llama-3B and Llama-3B + FT models achieving higher coverage than the Llama-1B and Llama-1B + FT models across all k values. At k = 2⁰, coverage starts around 0.35 for Llama-3B and Llama-3B + FT, and approximately 0.2 for Llama-1B and Llama-1B + FT. Coverage plateaus near 0.5 for Llama-3B and Llama-3B + FT, and around 0.4 for Llama-1B and Llama-1B + FT as k approaches 2⁸. The plot is rendered in a 3D perspective, but the data is effectively 2D with the z-axis being a visual artifact of the projection.
